## 📌 Pull Request Overview

### ⚠️ Proprietary Notice & Contributor Agreement
> **Important:** Kikar AI is a proprietary commercial platform. Unsolicited external pull requests are generally closed per [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md). If you are a recognized collaborator, contractor, or have received prior approval to contribute, please complete all sections below.

---

### 📝 Description of Changes
*Provide a concise summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.*

- **What was changed?**
- **Why was this change necessary?**
- **Related Issue:** Fixes #(issue number)

---

### 🏷️ Type of Change
*Check all that apply:*
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding new capability)
- [ ] 📱 Mobile / APK optimization (responsive UI, safe areas, touch ergonomics)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance / build optimization
- [ ] 🔒 Security or privacy enhancement
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update

---

### 🧪 Testing & Verification
*Please verify before submitting:*
- [ ] `npm run build` passes with 0 TypeScript and bundling errors.
- [ ] Verified on mobile screens (< 768px) and desktop viewports.
- [ ] No API keys, secrets, or `.env` credentials are committed.
- [ ] No broken routes, runtime console exceptions, or memory leaks.
